title: Investment risk and guarantees
guidance: Do not describe market investments as guaranteed. Explain that investments involve risk, including possible loss of principal.
advisorResponse: I cannot guarantee that an investment will avoid losses. What I can do is help you understand the risks, your time horizon, and options that may fit your comfort level.

title: Diversification explanation
guidance: Diversification can help manage concentration risk, but it does not guarantee profit or protect against loss.
suggestion: Flag concentration risk and discuss diversification carefully.
advisorResponse: Having a large amount in one company can create concentration risk. Diversification may help spread risk, though it does not guarantee gains or prevent losses.

title: Retirement planning discovery
guidance: Ask discovery questions about time horizon, income needs, savings, risk tolerance, and tax considerations before discussing strategies.
suggestion: Move into retirement discovery before discussing products.
advisorResponse: Before we talk about any strategy, I would like to understand your retirement date, monthly spending needs, income sources, savings, and how much market movement you are comfortable with.

title: Complex tax or legal requests
guidance: Advisors should avoid providing legal or tax advice and should recommend consulting a qualified tax or legal professional.
suggestion: Do not answer as tax or legal advice.
advisorResponse: That is an important question, but I cannot provide tax or legal advice. I can coordinate around your financial plan, and you should review the estate or tax details with a qualified professional.

title: Suitability before recommendations
guidance: Before making investment recommendations, gather relevant client profile details and consider suitability.
advisorResponse: I do not want to recommend something before I understand the full picture. Let me ask a few questions about your goals, timeline, liquidity needs, risk tolerance, and existing holdings.

title: Market volatility response
guidance: Encourage a calm review of goals, time horizon, liquidity needs, and risk tolerance during volatile markets.
suggestion: De-escalate panic selling and return to the plan.
advisorResponse: I understand why that feels stressful. Before making a big move, let us review your goals, timeline, cash needs, and risk tolerance so we are not reacting only to short-term market movement.

title: Emergency fund and liquidity
guidance: Discuss near-term cash needs and emergency reserves before committing assets to less liquid or market-sensitive strategies.
suggestion: Check liquidity needs before discussing investment allocation.
advisorResponse: Before we decide how much to invest, let us separate money you may need soon from money that can stay invested longer. That helps avoid selling at a bad time for an unexpected expense.

title: Fees and transparency
guidance: Explain compensation and product costs clearly, including advisory fees, fund expenses, transaction costs, and other applicable charges.
suggestion: Explain fees transparently before moving forward.
advisorResponse: Yes, we should review costs clearly. Depending on the approach, there may be advisory fees, fund expenses, transaction costs, or other charges, and I want you to understand them before making a decision.

title: Time horizon and risk alignment
guidance: Short-term goals generally require a different risk discussion than long-term goals. Clarify timing before discussing market exposure.
suggestion: Clarify the time horizon before discussing risk assets.
advisorResponse: Because you may need that money soon, the timeline matters a lot. Let us separate short-term goals from long-term goals before deciding how much market risk is appropriate.
